# Kanaan Guest Farm

> Family-run guest farm in Hazyview, Mpumalanga, South Africa — affordable self-catering accommodation and a wedding & gatherings venue, 48 minutes from Kruger Mpumalanga International Airport and 30–45 minutes from a Kruger National Park gate. From R250 per person sharing.

Kanaan Guest Farm is owned and managed by Anneli and Matthew (since August 2025). Accommodation includes self-catering lodge rooms, twin rooms, backpacker beds and peaceful campsites under forty-year-old mango trees. It is a relaxed, budget-friendly base for the Kruger National Park and the Panorama Route. Hazyview is not a malaria area. Bookings and enquiries are handled primarily via WhatsApp.

## Key facts
- Location: R40, Hazyview, Mpumalanga, 1242, South Africa
- From: R250 per person sharing per night (well below the regional average)
- Sleeps: ~50 across lodge rooms, twin rooms and 8 backpacker beds; 10 campsite pitches (camping for up to 120)
- Weddings & events: 60 indoors, 100 with a marquee, 150 with camping
- Distances: 48 minutes from KMIA airport; 30–45 minutes from a Kruger gate
- Check-in 14:00–22:00; check-out 05:00–10:00
- Contact: WhatsApp +27 63 794 3880 · bookings@kanaanguestfarm.com
